prefabs.name: Sparkle — BlueNoMid Base
prefabs.prompt: Sparkle BlueNoMid heroine in base form: only cobalt torso, floating head, detached hands and feet, minimal luminous cobalt-and-pale-cyan palette, no accessories

prefabs.name: Sparkle — Pulse Sash
prefabs.prompt: Sparkle BlueNoMid with Pulse Sash: diagonal electric-blue-white chest sash added over cobalt torso, hand snap motion on Head Flick, sash flares on kick beats

prefabs.name: Sparkle — Prism Skirt
prefabs.prompt: Sparkle BlueNoMid with Prism Skirt: wide diamond-cut skirt fanning in visible-spectrum gradient panels from waist to knee, detached hands arc wide during spins, pulse sash still visible above skirt

prefabs.name: Sparkle — Halo Rig
prefabs.prompt: Sparkle BlueNoMid with Halo Rig: shoulder-mounted halo ring, dual ribbon-cables flowing to detached hands, prism skirt and pulse sash visible, cables snap on beat hits

prefabs.name: Sparkle — Light Envisioned
prefabs.prompt: Sparkle BlueNoMid in full Light Envisioned transformation: crown-halo above head, five spectral ribbon-blades radiating from torso, full radiance luminance, all prior tiers visible beneath the transformation

prefabs.name: LiteMite — Prism Bloom
prefabs.combat_pattern: slow rotation, six-pointed burst tips telegraph lane hits one-at-a-time, steady predictable rhythm
prefabs.prompt: LiteMite boss Prism Bloom: slow-rotating six-pointed prism burst, golden-warm core, spectral shimmer tips, 8-segment syncrosequence tail drifting leftward, swarm of 4 circling motes, dark background Flash sprite

prefabs.name: LiteMite — Glue Braid
prefabs.combat_pattern: slow off-beat stall rhythm, ribbon weft snaps on every other snare, stickiest most disruptive of all archetypes
prefabs.prompt: LiteMite boss Glue Braid: three viscous amber blobs in a braid with electric-blue-white ribbon wefts, slow sticky drift, tail in reverse S-curve, Flash enemy sprite

prefabs.name: LiteMite — Ember Choir
prefabs.combat_pattern: trefoil orbit scatters motes across three lanes simultaneously, requires multi-lane response timing
prefabs.prompt: LiteMite boss Ember Choir: trio of molten amber-pink petals orbiting a pale-violet center in trefoil, each trailing ember dust wisps, Flash enemy sprite

prefabs.name: LiteMite — Halo Scythe
prefabs.combat_pattern: scythe arc sweep telegraphs one lane hard then immediately crosses to the opposite lane — punishes linear tracking, rewards pattern anticipation
prefabs.prompt: LiteMite boss Halo Scythe: icy silver-blue ring with four-point burst, offset halo sweeping like a scythe, crimson accent slash, rigid scythe-tooth tail segments, Flash enemy sprite

prefabs.name: LiteMite — Luster Knot
prefabs.combat_pattern: five motes each telegraph a different lane in rapid sequence, final boss — demands the player hold all four lanes in a rolling window while maintaining combo
prefabs.prompt: LiteMite boss Luster Knot: three deep-violet spheres in a triangular knot framed by a five-pointed golden burst, five satellite motes orbiting, tail knotted in a figure-8, Flash enemy sprite
